drivingQuestion: Why must there be an act of redemption at all, and up to what shortfall may property be redeemed in the mishna's manner?
outcomeNote: The mishna's wording is explained by R' Abbahu's reason, its author identified as not Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, and the Rabbis' limit fixed at half by Rav Sheshet.

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ לְמָה לִי לְמֵימַר ״הַפּוֹדֶה פּוֹדֶה״? מִשּׁוּם דְּרַבִּי אֲבָהוּ, דְּאָמַר רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ: שֶׁלֹּא יֹאמְרוּ הֶקְדֵּשׁ יוֹצֵא בְּלֹא פִּדְיוֹן.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «Why do I» need the mishna «to state» that «the one who redeems, redeems,» i.e., why isn’t the property given directly to the creditor without redemption? The Gemara answers: This is «due to» the explanation «of Rabbi Abbahu, as Rabbi Abbahu says:» The property is redeemed «so that» people «will not say» that «consecrated» property «exits» to non-sacred status «without redemption.»

segments.he: מַתְנִיתִין דְּלָא כְּרַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל, דְּתַנְיָא: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: אִם הָיָה חוֹבוֹ כְּנֶגֶד הֶקְדֵּשׁוֹ — פּוֹדֶה,
segments.en: The mishna teaches that if one consecrated property worth nine thousand dinars and his debt was ten thousand dinars, the creditor lends an additional dinar to the debtor for him to redeem the property. The Gemara notes: «The mishna is not in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, as it is taught» in a baraita that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: If his debt corresponded» to the value of «his consecrated» property, then the debtor «redeems» the property in the manner prescribed in the mishna.

segments.he: וְאִם לָאו — אֵינוֹ פּוֹדֶה. וְרַבָּנַן, עַד כַּמָּה? אָמַר רַב הוּנָא בַּר יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת: עַד פַּלְגָא.
segments.en: «But if» the value of the consecrated property is «not» enough to cover the debt, «he does not redeem» the property in this manner. Instead, it must be redeemed in accordance with its value. The Gemara asks: «And» according to «the Rabbis, up to what amount» may the property be redeemed in the manner described in the mishna? «Rav Huna bar Yehuda says» that «Rav Sheshet says:» The consecrated property must be worth «at» least «half» of the debt. If the property is worth less, it may be redeemed only in accordance with its monetary value.
